description: a strong man heavenly avenger with short dark hair and a stern face, a ring of bright golden fire like a burning halo behind the head, heavy silver and white plate armour with gold trim and large round pauldrons, a long dark red tabard with a golden sun, a brown belt, a long white cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, silver greaves and boots, no sword and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the fiery halo to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look in detail: face, hair, headwear, armour, robes, cloak and colours; the hands empty, without the flaming sword
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
